cases.given: Verified company signatory; valid delegation and exact issued quote hash
cases.when: Actor signs using pilot-approved method with accepted terms
cases.then: Only exact QuoteVersion transitions to ACCEPTED with immutable proof, otherwise remain ISSUED

cases.given: Portal Viewer with requester capability but without separately verified signer authority
cases.when: Actor attempts quote accept
cases.then: DENY; no QuoteVersion state or Outbox acceptance event

cases.given: Quote ISSUED with expiry and parallel supersede command
cases.when: Authorized signer accepts at boundary
cases.then: Single authoritative valid transition; expired/superseded version cannot be accepted

cases.given: Previously successful signatory acceptance and identical idempotency key
cases.when: Client retries after timeout
cases.then: Same logical acceptance and evidence, no duplicate customer commitment/event

cases.given: Authorized user from CustomerOrg-Y or provider Tenant-B but quote belongs to CustomerOrg-X
cases.when: Submit accept using guessed quoteId
cases.then: DENY and no terms/signature visibility

cases.given: Current ISSUED QuoteVersion; customer has explicit decline authority
cases.when: Customer declines with allowed reason and expectedVersion
cases.then: QuoteVersion DECLINED with correct actor, audit and no Booking

cases.given: Customer only has quote:read permission
cases.when: Customer POST decline
cases.then: DENY without state write or side effects

cases.given: Authorized decline races customer acceptance and quote expiry
cases.when: Both commands execute against same version
cases.then: Exactly one lawful final transition; losers conflict/re-read

cases.given: Decline recorded with same request digest
cases.when: Retry decline command
cases.then: One logical decline/audit outcome, no duplicate outbound notifications

cases.given: External customer from another provider relationship
cases.when: Decline foreign QuoteVersion
cases.then: DENY with no quote existence disclosure

cases.given: User belongs to Tenant-B and separately to provider Tenant-A's CustomerAccount-X via grant
cases.when: User opens permitted Tenant-A order from customer workspace
cases.then: Only provider-scoped customer projection returned; no Tenant-A employee Membership

cases.given: Same user switches browser context by caller-supplied tenantId header
cases.when: Request Tenant-Z data using forged header
cases.then: DENY, server-derived trusted context unaffected

cases.given: Grant revocation and concurrent My Orders request
cases.when: Provider disables CustomerAccount membership while read is in flight
cases.then: New post-revoke authorization denies; in-flight semantics explicitly documented and DB-consistent

cases.given: Cached customer projection created before revocation
cases.when: User refreshes listing with active old JWT
cases.then: No stale customer data leakage after authoritative revoke; 401/403 as appropriate

cases.given: Two customers X/Y same provider Tenant-A
cases.when: Customer X asks list/filter with Y order IDs
cases.then: Only X's authorized subset; no count/fields from Y

cases.given: Trip STARTED and active custody; subscription enters SUSPENDED
cases.when: Authorized assigned driver records necessary POD/evidence under continuity policy
cases.then: Safety/evidence permitted and auditable, no cargo evidence lost; new discretionary booking blocked

cases.given: Tenant suspended and sales attempts new discretionary Booking
cases.when: Sales submits booking command
cases.then: DENY under agreed SaaS policy while evidence/recovery operations remain available

cases.given: Suspension transition races driver pickup/POD write
cases.when: Both operations commit concurrently
cases.then: Deterministic scoped continuity guard, no orphan evidence/custody

cases.given: SaaS service temporarily unreachable with safe-continuity policy version available
cases.when: Critical custody event retries
cases.then: Idempotent evidence accepted only under valid preapproved continuity scope; logs decision

cases.given: Suspended Tenant-A driver tries read another Tenant-B Trip
cases.when: Call via continuation privileges
cases.then: DENY; safe continuity does not grant cross-tenant access

cases.given: Quote ISSUED, customer changes cargo weight
cases.when: Sales submits versioned amendment, obtains approvals as configured
cases.then: New QuoteVersion created, original immutable and prior assumptions invalidated explicitly

cases.given: Quote ACCEPTED and stale RFQ edit request
cases.when: Customer tries direct mutation to old QuoteVersion or active Booking
cases.then: DENY; persisted change request only, no stealth contract mutation

cases.given: Customer acceptance races issuance of replacement quote version
cases.when: Two commands use expectedVersion
cases.then: Only one coherent signed version remains effective; no mixed price/cargo snapshots

cases.given: Identical amend request repeated after response timeout
cases.when: Client retries with idempotency key
cases.then: One change proposal and one new version at most, no duplicate approval requests

cases.given: Sales from unrelated legal entity attempts amendment
cases.when: Submit change for foreign customer quote
cases.then: DENY and no buy/sell details leak

cases.given: CarrierOffer OFFERED then SELECTED and supplier confirms valid held vehicle
cases.when: Fleet confirms exclusive reservation with correct carrier authority
cases.then: Only CapacityReservation CONFIRMED authorizes Booking predicate; OFFER SELECTED alone does not

cases.given: Carrier withdraws before reservation confirmation
cases.when: Dispatcher attempts Booking.CONFIRMED based on SELECTED offer
cases.then: DENY/resource pending and supplier exception; no fake capacity

cases.given: Offer expiry/withdrawal races Fleet hold confirmation

cases.then: No confirmation based on invalidated offer or stale authority; failure reconciled

cases.given: Provider processes carrier acknowledge callback twice
cases.when: Same callback/outbox id replayed
cases.then: Single logical carrier ack/reservation effect and versioned audit

cases.given: Carrier-C receives buy offer with sell quote, margin and other carrier data
cases.when: Carrier reads view via its grant
cases.then: Only own offer/public shipment terms returned; provider margin/cross-carrier fields absent

cases.given: Vehicle/driver/trailer free for specified UTC interval
cases.when: Fleet commits HELD and validates confirmation
cases.then: Single valid reservation and holdExpiry/version recorded atomically

cases.given: Overlapping active reservation exists for same indivisible resource
cases.when: Second dispatcher reserves overlapping interval
cases.then: DB enforces conflict, no second HELD/CONFIRMED

cases.given: Two dispatchers and hold expiry job compete for same slot
cases.when: Concurrent HELD/CONFIRM/EXPIRE operations execute
cases.then: At most one compatible final reservation; stale expiry cannot free confirmed hold

cases.given: Crash after capacity transaction commits before notification
cases.when: Job retries from durable outbox

cases.given: Planner from ungranted Tenant-Z attempts Tenant-A vehicle hold
cases.when: Send vehicle ID and interval

cases.given: Cargo/route compliance assessed with qualified applicable rule source and reviewer

cases.then: Versioned legally applicable permit/assessment permits allowed transition as configured

cases.given: Critical jurisdiction/cargo permit status is UNKNOWN or DENY
cases.when: Dispatcher presses override/Start Trip
cases.then: DENY; pending HOLD with reason; no route/Trip READY/Booking allow

cases.given: Permit expires between assessment and Trip READY
cases.when: READY command checks current effective rule snapshot/version
cases.then: DENY or requalification; no stale compliance approval

cases.given: Late Compliance ALLOW event arrives after later DENY
cases.when: Consumer retries outdated event

cases.given: Reviewer with scope for another legal entity tries to release HOLD
cases.when: Submit approval for foreign cargo
cases.then: DENY, full audit of attempted release

cases.given: Reassigned/revoked driver forges new pickup observedAt after revocation

cases.given: Two drivers submit overlapping cargo-unit custody transfers at same instant
cases.when: Both commands compete on same CargoUnits

cases.given: Offline event resent five times after server crash

cases.then: Exactly one logical custody movement; no duplicate handover

cases.given: Carrier driver has grant for Trip-1, attempts Trip-2 under different Tenant

cases.given: 10 CargoUnits in custody, consignee accepts 8 and refuses 2
cases.when: Recipient signs partial POD
cases.then: 8 accepted, 2 retained with named custodian/disposition; Shipment not fully DELIVERED

cases.given: Receiver with invalid link or mismatched units attempts mark all delivered
cases.when: Submit POD for 10 though only 8 scanned/verified

cases.given: Driver and receiver concurrently submit overlapping POD/delivery attempts
cases.when: POD acceptance races reattempt for 2 units
cases.then: No double-counted accepted/returned quantities; per-unit conservation holds

cases.given: Duplicate signed POD callback or offline photos arrive out of order

cases.given: Receiver guest token for one DeliveryAttempt accesses other shipment
cases.when: Read/submit POD for foreign cargo
cases.then: DENY with no unrelated identity/cargo disclosure

cases.given: Booking confirmed, no Trip started, customer submits cancel request

cases.given: Customer sees cancel button while Trip.STARTED with custody

cases.given: Trip.STARTED occurs while cancellation approval commits
cases.when: Both commands operate same Booking expectedVersion
cases.then: One coherent outcome; no vehicle released with active custody

cases.given: Cancellation request and compensation event retransmitted

cases.then: One cancel request and at most one authorized compensation/release effect

cases.given: Customer from different provider relationship requests cancellation
cases.when: Post cancel for foreign Booking

cases.given: A pending owner invitation is bound to verified A legal entity and recipient

cases.given: Tenant-A has one active owner and a not-yet-accepted successor

cases.sideEffectOracle: No orphan-Tenant activation or misleading owner-revoked event

cases.sideEffectOracle: No second RFQSubmitted or QuoteRequested event

cases.given: Grant revoked in DB but old JWT, WS subscription and cached response remain
cases.when: Call HTTP, stream and async export after commit
cases.then: DENY all newly authorized data operations; close/re-authorize stream and export
cases.persistentOracle: No new read/export granted by stale token
cases.sideEffectOracle: No protected stream event or export delivery
cases.userVisibleOracle: UI shows revoked status; not stale data

cases.given: DB transaction committed and Outbox message delivered, acknowledgement lost
cases.when: Retry same message concurrently on two workers
cases.then: At-least-once transport, exactly one logical domain effect via inbox uniqueness
cases.persistentOracle: No duplicate Booking, invoice, custody or review row
cases.sideEffectOracle: Duplicate delivery acknowledged/dedup; not repeated notification side effect
cases.userVisibleOracle: Only one completed operation is visible; no duplicate notifications or ledger entries

cases.given: Manual delegated job queued under active role, role revoked before execution
cases.when: Use saved JWT/role snapshot to execute privileged operation
cases.then: DENY unauthorized new action; service principal only within explicit scoped job contract
cases.persistentOracle: Business aggregate unchanged, audit of revoked job attempt
cases.userVisibleOracle: Job marked denied/escalated; no silent success

cases.given: Failed job payload contains customer contact, driver location and finance data
cases.when: Inspect job metadata/log trace under support operator
cases.then: Redact protected fields, deny raw payload access
cases.persistentOracle: No unredacted payload in query/export/log for support audience
cases.sideEffectOracle: No raw replay/log artifact attached to support output
cases.userVisibleOracle: Only redacted reason code and correlation ID

cases.given: Booking confirmation failed/rolled back but old event arrives late
cases.when: Update customer My Orders from stale/replayed event
cases.then: Do not show authoritative CONFIRMED unless current valid Booking version; order events with version watermark
cases.persistentOracle: Canonical Booking remains pending/exception and projection eventual state converges
cases.sideEffectOracle: No customer booking success notification from invalid stale event
cases.userVisibleOracle: Pending/exception with freshness, not false confirmed

cases.given: Booking.CONFIRMED and driver/cargo assignment still active
cases.when: Customer posts cancellation request with cancel=true and fee=0 overposted
cases.then: Only request recorded; server derives terms/fees, Booking unchanged
cases.persistentOracle: No released capacity, no mutating fee from user-controlled field
cases.sideEffectOracle: No BookingCancelled event from customer command
cases.userVisibleOracle: Requested; awaiting decision

cases.given: Authorized cancellation and Trip.STARTED race on same Booking
cases.when: Commit actions concurrently with stale versions
cases.then: One coherent contract/custody branch; cannot free vehicle with active cargo
cases.persistentOracle: Either valid pre-start cancellation or execution exception; never both
cases.sideEffectOracle: No contradictory Cancelled and InExecution customer events
cases.userVisibleOracle: Single consistent status; exceptions displayed

cases.given: Service partial POD or undelivered with customer damage report
cases.when: Submit customer complaint with requested amount and altered POD fields
cases.then: Create scoped claim record only; no automatic evidence mutation/refund
cases.persistentOracle: POD immutable; money unchanged; claim linked to service
cases.userVisibleOracle: Complaint accepted for review independently of feedback

cases.given: Provider employee has Sales permission and can see customer records
cases.when: Submit private review as customer using forged customerAccountId
cases.then: DENY; only verified customer feedback capability on eligible completed service
cases.persistentOracle: No review or public rating created
cases.userVisibleOracle: Review submission denied; existing original untouched

cases.given: app DB principal with no `BYPASSRLS`, tenant context unset
cases.when: select protected row
cases.then: deny/zero access according to policy, never all tenants

cases.given: Tenant-A uses pooled Connection-1, then Tenant-B obtains same physical connection
cases.when: B queries A row
cases.then: no A data; transaction-local tenant context reset proven

cases.given: trusted authentication context Tenant-A, request body/header claims Tenant-Z
cases.when: command is invoked
cases.then: request-supplied tenant ignored/rejected, DB write stays A or DENY

cases.given: app writes aggregate+audit+outbox
cases.when: throw before DB commit
cases.then: none of the three records persists

cases.given: DB commit succeeded, outbox dispatch dies before ack
cases.when: restart dispatcher twice
cases.then: exactly one logical consumer effect, durable event retained until ack

cases.given: inbox event id E already applied with payload digest H1
cases.when: reprocess same E with H2
cases.then: conflict/quarantine; no silently accepted mutation

cases.given: two worker instances claim same due job
cases.when: simultaneous claim/reclaim
cases.then: one fenced lease owner, no stale worker commit

cases.given: Tenant-A + Customer-X/Y share provider
cases.when: X/Y queries same provider via app API
cases.then: account-level ABAC still denies cross-customer; RLS tenant check alone is insufficient

cases.given: illegal module uses direct imported JPA repository from another module
cases.when: Modulith `ApplicationModules.verify()`
cases.then: build/test fails until boundary corrected

cases.given: schema migrations boot from empty DB, and from known previous schema
cases.when: run Liquibase V1→V2 upgrade + idempotent rerun
cases.then: repeatable deterministic schema with no manual application superuser DDL

cases.given: invalid/expired or forged JWT actor and tenant headers
cases.when: HTTP request
cases.then: 401/403/404 ProblemDetail, no unverified tenant context or data

cases.given: PostGIS point proximity in lon/lat
cases.when: `ST_DWithin` query with meter semantics
cases.then: trusted SRID/geography units + tenant scope; invalid/foreign coordinate rejected
